purpose: G2: is the BIKE-Flip v5.2 first-round protection term T_1 = ft(S0)+delta (spec p.14) load-bearing at production parameters, under the spec's own decoder? Ablate delta1 in {0, delta, 2*delta}, everything else spec-exact.

design.pool: same archived L1 RAND pool, 16 keys
design.implementation: a faithful local copy of bike_flip with T_1 decoupled; the spec arm is REQUIRED to reproduce the frozen decoder bit-exactly (equivalence gate) before any ablation number is interpreted

amendments.id: amendment-1 (fourth arm, appended after the fact)
amendments.disclosure: The frozen protocol lists three arms (spec / no_first_round_delta / double_first_round_delta). A fourth arm, first_round_delta_only (d1=delta, d_rest=0), was added in the implementation and is reported in the results (two-round convergence 6.14%). It is appended here for the record; the three frozen arms and the equivalence gate are unchanged.
amendments.metric_note: The protocol's analysis field names 3-round and 7-round fractions; what is reported is 2-round and 3-round fractions plus the mean convergence iteration, because the fixed-iteration loop makes a 7-round fraction identically 1.
